# Soul pacing trials

Seeds 1–8, rare penguin, shrouded weapon, normal difficulty. Human bot: 16-tick reaction and every seventh tap wide. Each row spans all four temperaments. Level 20 assumes 30 earned marks in the gift’s path; this is potential, not free progress.

Times include stalk and reap, averaged only over absorptions. Careful play understates defensive powers. This does not measure physical comfort, cooperative balance or player enjoyment.
